rows.text: Il cartello localizza un attraversamento pedonale: occorre rallentare e, se necessario per dare precedenza ai pedoni, fermarsi.

issues: 26166: The cited DPR 495/1992 art. 135(9) specifies roads where motorway rules apply, and Codice della strada art. 175(2)(b) restricts other motor vehicles by mass. The cited Turin manual lists quadricycles as permitted without addressing that restriction; the draft merely says other limits apply and does not resolve this material conflict or explain what restrictions affect these quadricycles. Verify the applicable categories against current authority and revise the explanation and evidence without changing the printed verdict.
